import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Load the dataset from the string
data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# --- Visualization ---

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))

# Plot 1: Distribution of transaction amounts by type
sns.stripplot(
    ax=axes[0],
    data=df,
    x='transaction_type',
    y='amount',
    hue='transaction_type',
    size=10,
    jitter=False,
    palette="flare",
    legend=False
)
axes[0].set_title('Transaction Amounts by Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# Plot 2: Transaction amounts over the day
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[1],
    data=df,
    x='hour_of_day',
    y='amount',
    hue='transaction_type',
    size='amount',
    sizes=(100, 500),
    style='transaction_type',
    palette="mako",
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.8
)
axes[1].set_title('Transaction Activity Throughout the Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].legend(title='Transaction Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
axes[1].set_xticks(range(0, 25, 2)) # Set x-ticks to be more readable for hours

# Add a main title for the entire figure
fig.suptitle('Analysis of Transaction Data', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout to prevent labels from overlapping
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')

plt.close()
